aiden.goDeeper.body.en: Aiden, the 10X ORG expert GPT, knows the [Katalog](term:katalog) and the book. Describe the constraint you face and ask which kata to start with, then design it as a safe-to-try experiment. Try: *“It is unclear to me yet what an elevating kata looks like in practice. Give me examples.”* or *“How do I reduce dependencies and increase adaptability in my org?”*
aiden.goDeeper.body.text: Aiden 是 10X ORG 的专家 GPT，熟悉 [Katalog](term:katalog) 和这本书。描述您面临的约束，问问该从哪个 kata 开始，然后把它设计成可安全尝试的实验。试试：*“我还不清楚一个 elevating kata 在实践中是什么样子。给我举些例子。”*或*“如何减少我所在组织的依赖并提高适应性？”*

aiden.goDeeper.title.en: Learn how to apply the katas with Aiden
aiden.goDeeper.title.text: 与 Aiden 一起学习如何应用 kata

book.heading.en: See the katas at work in 10X ORG
book.heading.text: 在 10X ORG 中看 kata 如何运作

book.lead.en: *10X ORG* lists every Elevating Kata. The chapters show them at work: the Elevate step of the [MADE](term:made) method, tailwind career paths, multi-team line management and [Obeya](term:obeya).
book.lead.text: *10X ORG* 列出了每一个 Elevating Kata。各章展示它们的实际运用：[MADE](term:made) 方法的 Elevate 步骤、顺风职业路径、多团队线性管理和 [Obeya](term:obeya)。

case-studies.heading.en: Selected Case Studies Rich with Katas
case-studies.heading.text: 富含 Kata 的精选案例

elevation.figure.alt.en: Elevating Katas: a big arrow lifts a web of narrow, dependent units in the bottom left toward a team of teams in the top right, labelled Elevate to Adaptive Topology
elevation.figure.alt.text: Elevating Katas：一支大箭头把左下角由狭窄、相互依赖的单元织成的网，托向右上角的团队的团队，标注为 Elevate to Adaptive Topology

elevation.heading.en: Elevate toward the top right of the map

elevation.items.0.text.en: The katas are not meant to be applied top-to-bottom. They form a menu of deliberate moves. The right starting point depends on where an organization’s constraints sit on the map.
elevation.items.0.text.text: 这些 kata 不是要从上到下依次应用。它们构成一份刻意行动的菜单。正确的起点取决于组织的约束在地图上的位置。

elevation.items.1.text.en: Organizations typically begin with a few katas that match their most pressing design challenges, then expand or shift their use as learning accumulates.
elevation.items.1.text.text: 组织通常从几个与最紧迫的设计挑战相匹配的 kata 开始，随着学习的积累再扩大或调整使用范围。

elevation.items.1.title.text: 从小处开始，再逐步扩大

elevation.items.2.text.en: In service organizations, “product” maps to a service offering, customer journey, case type or operational capability. Backlogs become service queues; reviews become service inspections.
elevation.items.2.text.text: 在服务型组织中，“产品”对应服务内容、客户旅程、案件类型或运营能力。待办事项变成服务队列，评审变成服务检查。

elevation.lead.en: Elevating is a deliberate move right and up on the [Org Topologies map](term:org-topologies-map): broader skills and broader work mandates, from delivering outputs to delivering outcomes.
elevation.lead.text: 提升是在 [Org Topologies 地图](term:org-topologies-map)上刻意地向右、向上移动：更宽的技能和更宽的工作权责，从交付产出走向交付成果。

in-cases.lead.en: Every published case study, read for the katas it describes. A filled dot means the organization applied the kata; a ring means it was proposed or planned. Hover a dot to see how it showed up, or click a code to read the kata.
in-cases.lead.text: 每一篇已发布的案例，都按其中描述的 kata 来解读。实心圆点表示该组织应用了这个 kata；空心圆环表示已提出或已计划。悬停在圆点上可看它如何体现，点击代码可阅读该 kata。

katalog.explanation.paragraphs.0.en: Jay Galbraith’s Star Model™ teaches that an organization is not just its org chart or the sum of its policies, but **a system of interconnected design choices** that must be made deliberately and kept in sync.
katalog.explanation.paragraphs.0.text: Jay Galbraith 的 Star Model™ 指出，组织不只是组织架构图，也不只是各项政策的总和，而是**一个由相互关联的设计选择构成的系统**，必须有意识地做出这些选择并保持同步。

katalog.explanation.paragraphs.1.en: Five elements make up the star: the **org design criteria** derived from strategy, **structure**, **processes**, **rewards** and **people**. When they are aligned and reinforce one another, performance becomes more reliable and less accidental.
katalog.explanation.paragraphs.1.text: 星形由五个要素构成：源自战略的**组织设计准则**、**结构**、**流程**、**奖励**和**人员**。当它们彼此对齐、相互强化，绩效就会更可靠，更少出于偶然。

katalog.explanation.paragraphs.2.en: Change only one and the others pull back. A company that adopts Scrum as a process add-on, while hiring, rewards and structure stay as they were, gets the predictable result: “Agile is dead.” The katas work on all five elements, so change becomes systemic.
katalog.explanation.paragraphs.2.text: 只改其中一个，其他的会把它拉回去。一家公司把 Scrum 当作流程上的附加品，而招聘、奖励和结构原封不动，结果完全可以预料：“敏捷已死”。这些 kata 作用于全部五个要素，所以变革是系统性的。

katalog.explanation.quote.source.en: Jay R. Galbraith, quoted in 10X ORG

katalog.explanation.quote.text.en: People behave according to how they are measured, organized, and rewarded.
katalog.explanation.quote.text.text: 人们的行为取决于他们如何被衡量、被组织和被奖励。

katalog.figure.alt.en: Jay Galbraith’s Star Model™: Org Design Criteria at the top, with Structure, Processes, Rewards and People around a five-pointed star
katalog.figure.alt.text: Jay Galbraith 的 Star Model™：顶部是组织设计准则，五角星周围是结构、流程、奖励和人员

katalog.figure.credit.en: STAR MODEL™, JAY R. GALBRAITH · PUBLISHED WITH PERMISSION OF SASHA GALBRAITH OF GALBRAITH MANAGEMENT CONSULTANTS, LLC
katalog.figure.credit.text: STAR MODEL™，JAY R. GALBRAITH · 经 GALBRAITH MANAGEMENT CONSULTANTS, LLC 的 SASHA GALBRAITH 许可发布

katalog.lead.en: [Katalog](term:katalog) groups the katas by the five elements of org design in Jay Galbraith’s Star Model™. Change one element and the others must follow. Every kata links to its description and to the case studies that apply it.
katalog.lead.text: [Katalog](term:katalog) 按 Jay Galbraith 的 Star Model™ 中组织设计的五个要素给 kata 分组。改变一个要素，其他要素必须跟着变。每个 kata 都链接到它的说明，以及应用它的案例。

katalog.source.en: Element definitions are quoted from 10X ORG, which also lists the full Katalog.
katalog.source.text: 要素的定义引自 10X ORG，书中也列出了完整的 Katalog。

page.description.en: Elevating Katas are repeatable routines that turn org design intent into lived behavior, grouped by the Star Model and shown in real case studies.
page.description.text: Elevating Katas 是可重复的例行练习，把组织设计的意图变成真实的行为。它们按 Star Model 分组，并在真实案例中呈现。

systemic.heading.en: Five ways katas move the whole system
systemic.heading.text: Kata 推动整个系统的五种方式

systemic.items.0.lines.0.en: A kata never tweaks one element in isolation: it touches governance, roles, events, practices and artifacts together, as the [Star Model](term:star-model) asks.
systemic.items.0.lines.0.text: Kata 从不孤立地调整某一个要素：正如 [Star Model](term:star-model) 所要求的，它同时触及治理、角色、活动、实践和工件。

systemic.items.1.lines.0.en: Routines such as multi-team Product Backlog Refinement or vertical slicing bring the strategic goal into the daily work, so structure and process follow strategy.
systemic.items.1.lines.0.text: 多团队 Product Backlog 梳理或纵向切分之类的例行练习，把战略目标带进日常工作，让结构和流程跟随战略。

systemic.items.2.lines.0.en: Katas like *Elevate Product Ownership* stretch roles beyond their old definitions; repeated practice grows the skills the new design needs.
systemic.items.2.lines.0.text: 像 *Elevate Product Ownership* 这样的 kata 把角色拓展到旧定义之外；反复练习培养出新设计所需的技能。

systemic.items.3.lines.0.en: Culture programs fail on abstract values. Katas change the working pattern itself, and the desired behavior (collaboration, customer focus, learning) comes with it.
systemic.items.3.lines.0.text: 文化项目败在抽象的价值观上。Kata 改变的是工作方式本身，期望的行为（协作、以客户为中心、学习）随之而来。

systemic.items.4.lines.0.en: Because a kata repeats, it closes its own feedback loop: faster cycle times, better product fit and more engaged teams reward the new habit.
systemic.items.4.lines.0.text: 因为 kata 会重复，它自己就闭合了反馈回路：更短的周期、更好的产品契合度和更投入的团队，都在奖励新习惯。

systemic.kicker.text: 让 KATA 保持系统性

systemic.lead.en: Leaders don't need another transformation program. Choose a handful of katas and make sure they are practiced faithfully: as the routines become habits, agility and resilience grow, and the culture follows the work.
systemic.lead.text: 领导者不需要又一个转型项目。选几个 kata 并确保忠实地练习：当例行练习变成习惯，敏捷性和韧性随之增长，文化也会跟着工作走。

top.lead.en: Structured, repeatable improvement routines that turn organizational design intent into lived behavior.
top.lead.text: 结构化、可重复的改进例行练习，把组织设计的意图变成真实的行为。

what.closer.text: [Elevating Katas](term:elevating-kata) ==由问题驱动，而非由方法论驱动。==

what.heading.en: A practiced sequence, not a one-off transformation
what.heading.text: 一套反复练习的动作，而非一次性转型

what.paragraphs.0.en: The term **kata** comes from martial arts, where it describes a practiced sequence used to build skill and judgment through repetition. In management it was popularized through Toyota: a studied, repeatable pattern for disciplined improvement.
what.paragraphs.0.text: **Kata（型）**一词源自武术，指通过反复练习来培养技能和判断力的一套动作。在管理领域，它因丰田而流行：一种经过研究、可重复的规范化改进模式。

what.paragraphs.1.en: The [10X Org](term:10x-org) principles set direction. The katas make that direction actionable. They are applied in the **Elevate** step of the [MADE](term:made) method, where insights from mapping, assessment and design turn into concrete change.
what.paragraphs.1.text: [10X Org](term:10x-org) 的原则指明方向，kata 让这个方向可以付诸行动。它们用于 [MADE](term:made) 方法的 **Elevate** 步骤，在这一步，映射、评估和设计得到的洞察转化为具体的变革。

what.paragraphs.2.en: Each kata targets a concrete constraint, such as team boundaries, decision rights, interfaces, policies or governance, and tests whether expanding [mandates](term:mandate) or reducing friction moves the system closer to the intended elevated state.
what.paragraphs.2.text: 每个 kata 针对一个具体的约束，如团队边界、决策权、接口、政策或治理，并检验扩大[权责](term:mandate)或减少摩擦，是否让系统更接近预期的提升状态。
